messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: fire example (BUGS volume 3?)
parts:
I couldn't find the Fire example on the BUGS site that's in our vol3/fire/
directory. Does anybody know where it came from?

It's listed as being slow in the to-do list, but it now converges very
fast. But I don't know what the "right" answers are.

- Bob

On June 15, 2013 06:09:07 PM EDT, Bob Carpenter <ca...@alias-i.com> wrote:

>
> I'm going through the remaining BUGS models to see if we can get them
> all running in Stan.
>
> vol2/schools converges to the right answer quickly with init=0, but
> takes 500 or so iterations to converge with random inits (they ran
> BUGS with 10K iterations for this example). It's also not the
> fastest model.
>
> The initializations provided with JAGS are only partial, which we
> don't have working yet for Stan. Can we set the test to zero init,
> or should I hand code an init file?
>
> - Bob
